content: Season two of Star Wars: Ahsoka is still months away, but Lucasfilm still took the opportunity to tease it a bit at D23. The company dropped the first trailer for the new season ahead of its January 20th, 2027 debut. The clip shows a darker, witchcraft-filled take on the Star Wars universe, with Grand Admiral Thrawn (blue skin, red eyes, and an unsettlingly calm demeanor) threatening to thrust the galaxy back into large-scale war after the fall of the Empire. [Media: https://youtu.be/Fdar7gTQnog] Ryan Gosling also took the stage at D23 to tease the upcoming Star Wars: Starfighter movie. Unfortunately, while some footage was shown, it was exclusive to those in the room, and Lucasfilm hasn’t officially released it online. There have been a few supposed leaks posted on social media, but we haven’t been able to verify their authenticity. However, it likely won’t be too long before the general public gets a look, with Star Wars: Starfighter scheduled to hit theaters on May 28th, 2027, starring Matt Smith, Aaron Pierre, Mia Goth, and more alongside Gosling. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Starfighter_Logo.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

chineseSummary: 距离《星球大战：阿索卡》第二季上映还有几个月的时间，但卢卡斯影业仍然借此机会在 D23 上稍微调侃了一下。该公司在 2027 年 1 月 20 日首播之前发布了新一季的第一部预告片。该剪辑展示了星球大战宇宙中更黑暗、充满巫术的一面，其中有元帅 […]
chineseContent: 距离《星球大战：阿索卡》第二季上映还有几个月的时间，但卢卡斯影业仍然借此机会在 D23 上稍微调侃了一下。该公司在 2027 年 1 月 20 日首播之前发布了新一季的第一部预告片。这段视频展现了星球大战宇宙的黑暗、充满巫术的一面，索龙元帅（蓝皮肤、红眼睛、举止令人不安的平静）威胁要在帝国灭亡后将银河系重新卷入大规模战争。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/Fdar7gTQnog]瑞恩·高斯林也在 D23 的舞台上预告了即将上映的《星球大战：星际战斗机》电影。不幸的是，虽然展示了一些片段，但它是房间里的人独有的，卢卡斯影业尚未在网上正式发布。社交媒体上发布了一些疑似泄密事件，但我们无法验证其真实性。然而，用不了多久，公众就会看到《星球大战：星际战斗机》将于 2027 年 5 月 28 日上映，由马特·史密斯、亚伦·皮埃尔、米娅·高斯等人与高斯林一起主演。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Starfighter_Logo.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]
